subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Graded readers 1 and 2: The Entertainment Tour / The School Show
outcomes: Read two graded readers and find key details.
Use story words like galaxy, sculpture and backstage.
Talk about your dream job with since and for.

tf.s: At the Science Museum, Hazim understood how hot-air balloons fly.
tf.why: Yes, he learned that at the museum.

tf.s: The boys take a photo in front of an amazing galaxy.
tf.why: Yes, the galaxy picture was amazing.

tf.s: Faisal says they can do another tour with their parents tomorrow.
tf.why: Yes, that helps Hazim feel better.

tf.s: A sculpture is a piece of art you can walk around.
tf.why: Yes, it is made from stone, metal or wood.

tf.s: Samar and Basma have been at the school show for two days.
tf.why: They have been there for two hours.

tf.s: Basma's dream is to become a make-up artist.
The lion at the door is a real lion.
tf.why: It is a performer wearing lion make-up.

tf.s: The performer has wanted to be a performer for a few days.
tf.why: He/she has wanted it for many years.

tf.s: The costume designer hopes performers all over the world will use her costumes one day.
Backstage is where the audience sits.
tf.why: Backstage is behind the stage, where performers get ready.

boxes.q: Where did Hazim learn how hot-air balloons fly?
boxes.why: He learned it at the Science Museum.

boxes.q: What do they take a photo in front of?
How long have Samar and Basma been at the show?
Who do the girls meet first backstage?
Why is Samar nervous at the classroom door?
boxes.why: She thinks it is a real lion.

boxes.q: I've wanted to be a writer ___ many years.
I've wanted to be a costume designer ___ I was small.
boxes.why: I was small is a point in time.

boxes.q: What does the audience do when they love a show?
boxes.why: People cheer to show they are happy.
The performer loves school shows and the audience's cheers.

mcq.q: What did Hazim understand at the Science Museum?
mcq.why: The museum taught him about hot-air balloons.

mcq.q: Whose dream is to become a make-up artist?
mcq.why: Basma wants to be a make-up artist.

o: Art made from stone, metal or wood that you can walk around
mcq.why: You can walk around a sculpture.

mcq.q: What does the costume designer hope?
o: That performers all over the world use her costumes one day
mcq.why: She dreams her costumes will be used everywhere.

mcq.q: Find a Present continuous sentence for the future in the story.
o: We're visiting an art gallery at one o'clock.

mcq.q: Complete: I've wanted to be a camera operator ___ I was eight.
mcq.why: I was eight is a point in time.

mcq.q: How does Faisal help Hazim feel better?
o: He says they can do another tour with their parents tomorrow and find the camera.
He gives Hazim his own camera.

mcq.q: Why does Samar think there is a real lion?
o: A performer is wearing lion make-up.
There is a lion in the classroom.
She hears a lion on TV.
She sees a lion costume in the shop.
mcq.why: The make-up artist painted the performer's face.

mcq.q: Which job from Unit 1 painted the lion's face?
Which is the best new ending for The Entertainment Tour?
o: Mr Talal finds the camera on the bus seat, and Hazim is very happy.
The boys meet a lion backstage.
mcq.why: It solves the problem of the lost camera.
